status: DRAFTED before any hybrid-teacher generation exists; REGISTERED (frozen, its sha256 bound into the grant) only on the maintainer's approval, and never amended after the first datum of A1 exists. The data budget's NUMBERS are derived by the rules below from A1's pilot slice; the rules are fixed now

arms.H-T-S: the common initialization trained on the H-T documents of I (tasks admitted in both modes)
arms.H-N-S: the same initialization trained on the H-N documents of I
arms.H-N-C: the same initialization trained on the H-N documents of I and X, X sized so its isolated pack has H-T-S's sequence count

isolated_variables.S: the teacher's mode on the same tasks: same task ids, same initialization, recipe, epochs, seeds and evaluation; the training compute differs (H-T documents are longer) and is reported beside, never equalized
isolated_variables.C: the teacher's mode at the same training compute: the same number of packed 8,192-token sequences, optimizer steps and epochs (equal FLOPs up to padding, which is reported); H-N-C sees more tasks

inside_the_variable._: these come with the mode, are reported, and are never read as the mode's isolated effect
inside_the_variable.trajectory_length: reasoning tokens exist only in H-T
inside_the_variable.admission: each mode's own correctness decides which of its trajectories are trainable; S restricts both to I
inside_the_variable.evaluation_mode: each student is measured in its own mode

seed_pairing: arms are paired by training-seed number; every directional label needs both seeds' own estimates on its side

fallback.when: X is infeasible under design.json :: tasks.X.if_infeasible, decided at $0 before any training
fallback.contrast: H-T-C - H-N-S, H-T-C = a seeded prefix of I's H-T documents (whole units) packed to H-N-S's sequence count
fallback.note: the fallback is compute-matched at the smaller scale, where the floor is likelier

multiplicity: two decided comparisons, S and C, each at a 97.5% interval (Bonferroni over the two); within each the four static-axis contrasts are a Holm family at alpha 0.05

evaluation.modes: students in their own training mode; the teacher in both
evaluation.think_state: every generation records the think_state its prompt produced; the preclosed state is scored with no think delimiter allowed in the continuation, and no earlier record or verdict changes
evaluation.every_item: every item of every unit is generated for every checkpoint and for the teacher in both modes

primary_measure: correctness on the 570 formal static items of fluid_reasoning_720 (dev_v1), one nucleus_v1 sample per item and seed, clustered by rule family; the interactive episodes exploratory

labels.GO_THINKING: the interval lies wholly above +5 pp and both seeds' estimates are above +5 pp
labels.GO_NON_THINKING: the interval lies wholly below -5 pp and both seeds' estimates are below -5 pp
labels.NO_GO: the interval and both seeds' estimates lie inside (-5, +5) pp and neither arm is below 2%: a meaningful difference between the modes is excluded at this scale
labels.NOT_RESOLVED: both arms below 2% (FLOOR); one arm below 2% flagged FLOOR_<arm>

decision_rule.reading: S and C are read separately and never merged: a mode that wins S and not C wins by compute, one that wins C and not S wins by data efficiency

data_budget_rules._: applied to A1's pilot slice before the rest of A1 is generated; recorded, then fixed
data_budget_rules.I: tasks whose every turn is admitted in both modes
data_budget_rules.steps: each arm: total_steps = ceil(3 x sequences / 2) (H1-PA's rule), sequences from pack_isolated at 8,192
data_budget_rules.X_size: the smallest whole-unit prefix of the seeded X order whose H-N documents, packed with I's, reach H-T-S's sequence count
data_budget_rules.repricing: the remaining A1 and A3 costs are recomputed from the slice's measured tokens per task, acceptance and length-limit share by forecast_cost.py; if the repriced total exceeds the phase cap, A stops at a HARD BOUNDARY with the data generated so far kept

teacher_correctness: per mode on every T0 task's first candidate (the teacher's correctness), and the two-candidate yield, per cell and axis; and on eval-set-1 per mode under nucleus_v1

sensitivity.registered_not_run: H-N generated under H-T's preset (0.6 / 0.95 / 20) on I, trained as H-N-S: isolates the sampling preset from the mode. Run only on a later maintainer decision

reported_beside: each static axis per arm and seed, unseen rule and unseen format tiers; the 144 interactive episodes (exploratory)
every eval-set-1 unit, correct AND usable side by side over its formal items, for every student and for the teacher in both modes
the teacher-student gap per unit and axis
protocol integrity: natural termination, degeneration stops, context-limit hits; think_state violations
reasoning and answer tokens per unit (generation lengths), and supervised tokens, context tokens, sequences and training FLOPs per arm
teacher correctness, admission rate, length-limit share and tokens per task, per mode and cell
training: loss curves and validation CE/KD (diagnostics only)
per arm: the pack's composition statistics and context_exposure (zero foreign context under isolation, reported to show it)
never: a re-rendered target, a hand-built mode prefix, a soft switch, or a mode-forcing system message
removing a thinking span from a thinking-mode trace to make a non-thinking target, or any answer-only cut of a Thinking-2507 trace
changing this rule, its constants, the evaluation set, the mask, the scorers or nucleus_v1 after a datum is seen
a pooled score across units, or usable rollout, KL, loss or length read as reasoning
selecting, dropping or re-running a seed for its result
combining the hybrid non-thinking teacher with the projected-residual architecture in this round (brief section 4)
starting any follow-up automatically from a result of this study
comparing a teacher mode and a context strategy in one contrast, or switching an arm's context strategy after a datum is seen

held_constant.context_strategy: document_isolated for every arm (design.json :: context_strategy): one packer, sequence length, placement rule and seeded order, and the trainer's batch.context_strategy, in every run's config hash. Chosen so the context distribution does not move with the mode; cross-context training stays a supported strategy and is not compared here
held_constant.evaluation_identity: configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/evaluation_identity.json: each mode's template, think state, instrument and scorer sources by sha256; frozen with this preregistration
